decisions.reason: The pipe cleaning box builds directly on the firm's fluid-handling and utility business, so its sales and production fit existing routines and customers, and one year of results gives no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search.

Public waste bins are distant from the core and more likely to fall short of aspirations, but they reach public-sector buyers the firm already serves, use its existing steel and coating capabilities, and are still too new to judge, so management carries them for now.
The ground sleeve line extends the firm's established fabrication offer at low added cost, so there is little reason for problemistic search after only one year.

Cast iron sleeves round out the ground sleeve range for existing customers, but they may overlap with the broader line and be consolidated if results lag aspirations, so the drop risk is slightly higher.
Steel ground sleeves draw on the firm's core steel processing and in-house surface treatment, so they are inexpensive to keep and fit its quality-driven strategy.
